question: इबुप्रोफेन वयस्क मान्छेले दिनको कति पटकसम्म खान सक्छ?
response_text:
एक वयस्कले आइबुप्रोफेन (ibuprofen) को दुई खुराकहरू बीच कम्तिमा ४ घण्टाको अन्तराल राख्नुपर्छ [1] ।

यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्न सकिएन:
- २४ घण्टामा एक वयस्कले सुरक्षित रूपमा लिन सक्ने आइबुप्रोफेनको अधिकतम खुराक कति हो।
- वयस्कका लागि आइबुप्रोफेनको मानक सिफारिस गरिएको एकल खुराक कति हो।
- के विशिष्ट स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाहरू वा औषधिहरूले एक वयस्कले प्रति दिन लिन सक्ने आइबुप्रोफेनको खुराकको संख्यालाई परिवर्तन गर्छन्।

Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) is a popular prescription and over-the-counter (OTC) pain reliever and fever reducer. It’s usually taken as needed, but you might take it on a schedule if you’re directed to by a healthcare professional. It’s common to take ibuprofen every 4 to 6 hours. The maximum dose for OTC ibuprofen is 1,200 mg per day. The maximum dose for prescription ibuprofen is up to 3,200 mg per day, depending on what you’re taking it for. Talk to your healthcare team before taking ibuprofen to make sure it’s safe for you. This is especially important for people living with kidney or liver problems or during pregnancy. Ibuprofen is available as a brand-name medication. But you can also find it as a lower-cost generic. Whether you’re experiencing back pain, headache or symptoms of the cold and flu, Ibuprofen is is an ingredient that relieves minor aches and pains and reduces fever.

MOTRIN® contains ibuprofen, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, or (NSAID). The Ibuprofen in MOTRIN® works by disrupting the release of prostaglandins, which the body produces in response to injury. These can cause pain and inflammation.

MOTRIN® temporarily reduces [fever](https://www.motrin.com/adults/cold-flu/managing-fever), but also temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to:

## What is ibuprofen?

[Ibuprofen](https://www.drugs.com/monograph/ibuprofen.html) is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory d

[source: https://www.drugs.com/ibuprofen.html]
rug (NSAID). It works by reducing hormones that cause inflammation and pain in the body.

Ibuprofen is used to reduce fever and treat pain or inflammation caused by many conditions such as [headache](https://www.drugs.com/cg/acute-headache.html), [toothache](https://www.drugs.com/cg/dental-cavities.html), [back pain](https://www.drugs.com/cg/back-pain.html), arthritis, menstrual cramps, or minor injury.

Ibuprofen is used in adults and children who are at least 6 months old.

## Warnings

Ibuprofen can increase your risk of fatal [heart attack](https://www.drugs.com/cg/heart-attack.html), heart failure, or stroke. Do not use this medicine just before or after heart bypass surgery (coronary artery bypass graft, or CABG).

Ibuprofen may also cause stomach or intestinal bleeding, which can be fatal. These conditions can occur without warning while you are using this medicine, especially in older adults.

Do not take more than your recommended dose. **An ibuprofen overdose can damage your stomach or intestines.** Use only the smallest amount of medication needed to get relief from your pain, swelling, or fever.

# How much ibuprofen can I take and how often?

Medically reviewed by [Carmen Pope, Senior Medical Editor, B. Pharm](https://www.drugs.com/support/editor/19/carmen-pope-senior-medical-editor-b-pharm.html). Last updated on July 18, 2025.

**Official Answer** by Drugs.com


**Adults can safely take [ibuprofen](https://www.drugs.com/ibuprofen.html) 200 mg to 400 mg (one or two tablets) every 4-6 hours as needed for pain relief.** The maximum dose in one day (24 hours) for over-the-counter ibuprofen is 1200 mg (6 tablets of 200 mg each).

Ibuprofen is **also available on a prescription from a doctor** and may be prescribed at a higher strength (600 mg or 800 mg every 6 hours) for severe pain. If you are taking ibuprofen under doctor supervision, then the maximum dose in 24 hours is 3200 mg.

You should always try and take the smallest dose needed that gives you relief.

### Safe Ibuprofen Dosing Schedule:

- **Standard dose:** 200-400 mg every 4-6 hours
- **Maximum frequency:** Every 4 hours
- **Daily limit (OTC):** 1200 mg maximum
- **Daily limit (Prescription):** Up

[source: https://www.drugs.com/medical-answers/how-often-can-you-take-ibuprofen-3016181/]
 to 3200 mg under medical supervision.

### Ibuprofen Timing Guidelines:

- **Minimum interval:** 4 hours between doses
- **Recommended interval:** 6 hours for regular use
- **With food:** Taking ibuprofen with food may reduce stomach irritation
- **Duration:** Use for the shortest time needed.

## FAQs about Ibuprofen

### How often can you take ibuprofen?

**You can take ibuprofen every 4 to 6 hours for pain and inflammation relief.** Never take ibuprofen more frequently than every 4 hours because taking ibuprofen too often increases the risk of side effects.

### How much ibuprofen is in a single dose?

A single dose of ibuprofen that has been brought over-the-counter (OTC) **usually contains 200 mg**. **Extra strength OTC ibuprofen tablets usually contain 400 mg.**

Some **prescription strengths** of ibuprofen contain an even higher dose, such as 600 mg or 800 mg. A **lways check the label on the packet to make sure you know what strength your ibuprofen tablet is.**

### How much ibuprofen can you take in a day?

**You should not take more than 6 tablets (1200mg) in 1 day** if you are not under the supervision of a doctor and **you have brought your ibuprofen over the counter**
